items: Know your audience: tailor the message to classmates, teachers or family.
Use visual aids: pictures, diagrams and props make a story clearer.
Be clear and concise: drop unnecessary details.
Show emotion with your voice and expressions to sound authentic.

blocks.text: Martin Luther King Jr.'s 'I Have a Dream' speech is remembered for how it was delivered as well as for its message: storytelling, emotion and clear communication made it unforgettable (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Discuss the role of communication and storytelling in building a brand and connecting with customers (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: Clear communication tells customers what the brand offers and listens to their feedback, building trust. Storytelling gives the brand a personality and emotional meaning, such as a founder's journey or a customer's success, so people remember it and feel connected. Used across ads, social media and service, these skills turn buyers into loyal customers who recommend the brand.

items: Improve: practise, know the audience, use visuals, be concise, show emotion.
